## About
Vanilla Bloom is a carefully curated Minecraft modpack designed to expand and refine the vanilla experience while preserving the charm and atmosphere that make Minecraft feel familiar.

The pack places a strong focus on visual quality, introducing enhanced lighting, improved textures, atmospheric effects, smoother animations, and a more immersive overall presentation. Every visual element is selected to create a cohesive and polished experience without losing Minecraft’s recognizable style.

Beyond visuals, Vanilla Bloom also includes gameplay additions, new content, and expanded progression designed to feel naturally integrated into the game. Rather than completely transforming Minecraft, these additions aim to enrich exploration, creativity, and long-term gameplay while maintaining a balanced and enjoyable experience.

Performance improvements and quality-of-life features are included throughout the pack to provide smoother gameplay and a more seamless experience.

Vanilla Bloom is ideal for players looking for an enhanced version of Minecraft that goes beyond traditional Vanilla+ while still feeling cohesive, immersive, and true to the spirit of the game.

_I originally made this modpack to play with my friends on a private server, but I decided to share it publicly so anyone can enjoy the experience._
**The shaders come pre-configured. I personally recommend Bliss Shaders or Eclipse Shaders, but the modpack also includes other great alternatives.**
